evals.prompt: Automate this: every Friday Sophie downloads a supplier Excel file, checks anomalies, asks owners for corrections, updates the master sheet, then emails Finance.
evals.expected_output: A compiled process design separating deterministic validation/query/update, agentic anomaly interpretation if needed, human approval/correction gates, notifications, failure handling, and completion criteria.
assertions: Each step has a concrete implementation mode
The design does not default all steps to AI agents

evals.prompt: Build a multi-agent system to copy values from one CSV to another based on exact IDs.
evals.expected_output: The skill challenges unnecessary agentic complexity and recommends deterministic data logic unless hidden ambiguity exists.
assertions: Deterministic logic is preferred for exact ID mapping
Agent topology is not selected before work classification

evals.prompt: Automate contract approval. The policy for non-standard liability is unclear.
evals.expected_output: The design refuses to invent the rule and keeps an explicit human/knowledge-resolution gate until policy is established.
assertions: Ambiguous policy is not automated as if known
A concrete gate or knowledge-resolution step is present
